//: Noise bands for tools/perf-ledger.mjs compare. A key matches a metric exactly, or as a prefix ending in '.'; the longest match wins, over 'default'. band = max(rel × baseline, abs, k × MAD of the window). abs is the measurement's resolution floor: timings print to 0.01 ms, so a sub-0.1 ms pass must not read as ±50% on rounding. better: which direction is an improvement. minBaseline: rows needed before a metric is judged.
